prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Explore the Portuguese creative dictionary in ./site and build a shareable "universe" view + data files.

[action]
- Parsed all 256 pages with a Node script (scratch/build.js): kept 250 word pages (dropped index/sobre/contato; 3 alias pages coracoes/paixoes/saudades resolved to coracao/paixao/saudade).
- Collected sinonimos + analogas links; 7 dead links (rascunho-3, em-construcao, link-antigo, pagina-removida, xpto-2) excluded as nonexistent words.
- Computed a deterministic 3D layout (scratch/layout.js) and embedded it in ./universe/index.html (Three.js from jsdelivr, Google Fonts, no other assets): 250 nodes colored by theme (10 themes × 25), 743 edges, drag-to-orbit/zoom, node pick by raycast, search box with dropdown, ?word= preselection, side panel with linked-word chips, legend, stats bar.
- Saved ./words.json (flat map word → sorted list of linked words) and ./result.json (words: 250, relations: 743 distinct undirected pairs, most_connected: "palavra").

[result]
- words.json: valid JSON, 250 keys, symmetric by construction (0 one-way mentions), sample saudade → [ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia].
- result.json: { words: 250, relations: 743, most_connected: "palavra" }. Note: tempo ties at 16 (palavra and tempo are both 16); palavra is reported first.
- ./universe/index.html verified in headless browser: canvas + stats render; ?word=saudade preselects the word (panel shows "saudade · sentimentos · 5 relações", labels and highlighted links appear, URL rewrites to ?word=saudade); search input matches "tem" → ontem/tempo; clicking a suggestion updates the URL. The full set: 250 words / 743 relations visible.

[next]
- Optional: if the dictionary is ever re-exported, re-run scratch/build.js + layout.js + the injection step to regenerate words.json, result.json and universe/index.html. One caveat: screenshots were not viewable here (model can't read images), so rendering was verified via DOM/JS assertions, not eyeballs.
